environment.kind: LOCAL injected EIP-1193 wallet wrapper over an isolated browser Ganache EVM

tests.name: rejects an ABI-compatible contract with different runtime bytecode
rejects an unsupported EVM chain before enabling payments
connects the exact contract on local chain 1337 and displays its three owners
wallet-mode deposit produces a mined local transaction and exact displayed balance
preflight rejects an unannounced account mismatch without broadcasting
preflight rejects an unannounced network mismatch without broadcasting
account-change event interrupts an open wallet request and unlocks the new account
chain-change event resets the session and unlocks reconnection during an open request
account disconnect clears payment controls without blocking reconnection
exact raw purpose text including surrounding whitespace verifies against an external commitment
altered local purpose metadata is rejected and never rendered as trusted content
previous confirmed transaction hashes remain visible after session changes

limitations: No real browser wallet extension was installed or exercised.
No public Ethereum or cloud blockchain network was contacted.
The wrapper deterministically controls account/network events for local integration testing; this does not establish external wallet acceptance.
